cases.command: echo a > /data/nwa && echo b > /data/nwb && touch -d '2024-01-01 00:00:00' /data/nwa && touch -d '2024-01-01 00:00:00.5' /data/nwb && find /data -maxdepth 1 -name 'nw*' -newer /data/nwa; rm -f /data/nwa /data/nwb
cases.note: GNU touch -d keeps the fraction and find -newer compares it (findutils 4.10, coreutils 9.7): the file half a second newer is listed.
